title: Sod Calculator
benefit: Rolls and Pallets for Your Lawn
cardBlurb: Square feet, rolls, and pallets of sod
metaDescription: Estimate square feet of lawn and how many sod rolls and pallets to order, with roll and pallet coverage you can match to your supplier and 5% extra for cuts.
secondaryKeywords: how much sod do i need
how many pallets of sod do i need
how many square feet in a pallet of sod
intent: Estimate square feet of lawn and how many sod rolls or pallets to order.
registerRow: Not on the Oct 2026 Keyword Register: category-fill addition (Garden Beds and Lawn) chosen by the redesign brief; lawn coverage, not mulch volume or topsoil.
intro: Enter your lawn as one to three rectangles to get the square feet of sod and how many rolls and pallets to order, using your supplier's roll and pallet sizes.
chartTitle: What you order: lawn, extra for cuts, and spare sod on the last pallet (sq ft)
diagramCaption: Plan of each lawn area with its dimensions. It redraws as you type.
uniqueAddition: Roll and pallet coverage you can match to your own supplier (extension guides show sizes vary by grower), the spare sod left on the last pallet, and a table of rolls and pallets at 450 and 500 sq ft pallet sizes.

inputs.name: areaCount
inputs.label: Lawn areas
inputs.help: Split an odd-shaped lawn into rectangles.

inputs.name: subtract
inputs.label: Beds, paths, and patios inside
inputs.help: Area inside the rectangles that won't get sod.

inputs.name: rollCoverage
inputs.label: Coverage per roll
inputs.help: Ask your supplier. Virginia Tech Extension says a standard roll is about 10 sq ft, but sizes vary.

inputs.name: palletCoverage
inputs.label: Coverage per pallet
inputs.help: Ask your supplier. Extension guides list pallets from about 450 to 700 sq ft depending on the grower.

inputs.name: waste
inputs.label: Extra to order
inputs.help: 0 to 25%. Mississippi State Extension suggests ordering about 5% more than you measure.

sources.title: Sod Source Selection, Installation, Maintenance, and Producers in Virginia, publication 418-040 (Virginia Cooperative Extension, Virginia Tech): standard roll about 10 sq ft; pallets about 450 to 700 sq ft depending on the grower
Sod Installation and Maintenance, publication P2951 (Mississippi State University Extension): pallets typically 450 to 500 sq ft; buy about 5 percent more sod than you think you need
How to Select and Install Sod (Texas A&M AgriLife Extension): measure the area and subtract the house and non-turf landscaping; some waste in installation from odd shapes
